messages:
Maya Patel: quick sync 1 want a single, customer-facing frame for segmentation + multi-region routing so PMs and Sales can price it. high-level decisions only here.
Ajay Singh: Agree. Main axis: isolation guarantees (soft quotas, fast evac) vs contractual fencing (dedicated pools, higher cost).
Nora Chen: Customers request three features: region pinning, per-tenant egress caps, and auditable routing trails. Compliance will require dedicated pools for some buyers.
Samir Rao: Infra reality: we can deliver a usable \"soft isolation\" product quickly by adding per-tenant cache quotas, QoS, and an eviction circuit-breaker on current fabric. Dedicated fencing is a separate engineering project.
Diego Morales: From Sales: need clear SKUs: \"Segmentation (standard)\" = shared fabric + quotas; \"Segmentation (enterprise)\" = dedicated pools + contractual SLA. Need price uplift ranges to start conversations.
Maya Patel: Proposed launch acceptance (standard): two pilot customers, canary rollout (0.1%->1%->5%), documented top-3 failure modes and mitigations, per-tenant telemetry (p50/p95/p99 latency + token counts).
Ajay Singh: Ops constraints: require \"isolation_health\" endpoint for canary gating, and auto-evac playbook. Evac fallback should route to compatible model variant in other region if capacity shortfalls occur.
Samir Rao: Technical notes: default per-tenant cache_quota = 256MB for standard SKU; bandwidth caps configurable per-tenant (suggest 50Mbps default). Will run sims to validate tail effects.
Nora Chen: Compliance asks recorded: audit logs exportable as JSONL, default retention 90 days, region-lock enforceable by contract. I'll collate any hard redlines.
Diego Morales: Sales asks: practical launch messaging 1 call out that standard SKU is \"shared-by-default, opt-in dedicated fencing after compliance review\". Want estimated pricing uplift for fence (ballpark +% ).
Maya Patel: Action items: Ill draft the spec + pricing bullets by Wed EOD. Samir to post cache & latency sims by Tues. Nora to produce compliance redline doc. Diego to prepare rough commercial language.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary job \"segmentation-std-canary\" started at 1777778000.
Maya Patel: Thanks 1 if anyone has customer-specific constraints, drop them here so we can fold into acceptance criteria.
